name: figma-lossless
description: Collect Figma REST evidence losslessly, compile it into a verifiable design contract, and gate UI implementations against that contract.

interface.shortDescription: Compile Figma evidence and enforce exact UI gates
interface.longDescription: Collect Figma REST evidence losslessly, compile it into a Design IR with property accounting, capture the implementation, and fail incomplete structure, copy, geometry, style, asset, visual, component, or flow coverage.
defaultPrompt: Collect this Figma screen and export a specification I can implement from.
Verify this UI implementation against its compiled Figma contract.
